status: FINAL - NORMATIVE (owner-locked 2026-09-17). Companion of POST-MATCH-INSIGHTS-SSOT.md; the Markdown SSOT and this file must agree.
supersedes: the 2026-09-16 'FINAL RECOMMENDATION' version of this file; tier-b-shape-definitions.json and candidate-definitions files are research evidence only

units.gold: team net-worth difference (your team minus enemy)
units.L(t): sum over your 5 players of stats.networthPerMinute[t] minus the same sum for the enemy; t = array index, read as minute t:00; the curve ends at the first t for which any of the ten arrays has no value
units.R(t): L(t) / (your team NW(t) + enemy NW(t)); 0 when the denominator is 0
units.core curve: L with its final 3 samples removed (L[0 .. len(L)-4]); if len(L) <= 3, L[0 .. 0]
units.CS(p, t): sum of stats.lastHitsPerMinute[0 .. t-1]; unknown if the array has fewer than t entries
units.bucket: STANDARD = gameMode ALL_PICK or ALL_PICK_RANKED with lobbyType RANKED or UNRANKED; TURBO = gameMode TURBO; anything else is not eligible
units.role: effective role per role-resolution-and-correction-v1.md; STRATZ position 1 carry, 2 mid, 3 offlane, 4/5 support is the research proxy
units.counterpart: carry -> enemy POSITION_3, mid -> enemy POSITION_2, offlane -> enemy POSITION_1; resolved only if exactly one such enemy exists and its map lane equals the viewer's (map lane: MID_LANE -> mid; SAFE_LANE -> bot for Radiant / top for Dire; OFF_LANE -> top for Radiant / bot for Dire)
units.major_patch: 7.xx from gameVersionId; lettered sub-patches are the same major patch (research ids: 180 = 7.39; 181 and 182 = 7.40)

global_eligibility: all ten players have a non-empty stats.networthPerMinute
no player has leaverStatus in {ABANDONED, AFK, DISCONNECTED_TOO_LONG, NEVER_CONNECTED, NEVER_CONNECTED_TOO_LONG, FAILED_TO_READY_UP, DECLINED_READY_UP}
positions: each team has exactly one each of POSITION_1..POSITION_5
feeding guard: no player has >= 8 deathEvents with time < 600 s (STANDARD) / 480 s (TURBO); if violated, no card of any kind

severity.ladder_level: v < q: ineligible; q <= v < s: (v - q) / (s - q); s <= v < e: 1 + (v - s) / (e - s); v >= e: min(3, 2 + (v - e) / (e - s)); band = 1 if level < 1, 2 if level < 2, else 3
severity.rounding: level is rounded to 3 decimal places before comparison

story_group.rule: keep at most one group card: the eligible member earliest in this list; drop the others before sorting

ranking.rank_class_direction: ascending: class 1 is shown before class 2, class 2 before class 3
ranking.select: first min(3, n) cards after sorting; n may be 0; never fill

history.window: the most recent 50 comparable prior values in the account's currently entitled retained history; prior = strictly earlier (startDateTime, then match id); comparable = globally eligible, not feeding-guarded, same comparator key, metric measurable (unknown is excluded, never zero)
history.N: number of values in the window (0..50)

claims.N<10: no historical wording of any kind
claims.10<=N<=19: median-only secondary line on an already-eligible card; never creates a card
claims.N>=20: record wording 'across your last N ...'; history-required cards become eligible
claims.N>=30: 'one of your 3 ...', 'top 10% of your last N', 'unusually ... for you' - continuous metrics only

history.line_precedence: at most one history line per card: record (N>=20) > rarity (N>=30, continuous) > median (N>=10)
history.record_rule: strict; must beat the previous record by the card's margin; an exact tie is never a record

rarity_definitions.top3: fewer than 3 window values are better than the current value (and it is not a record)
rarity_definitions.top10pct_or_unusual: current value is better than the window's 90th percentile (10th for timings), nearest-rank

history.patch_scope: same major patch applies ONLY to own and enemy item-timing comparisons
history.fallback: below the gate the history card is ineligible and enemy cards render without a line; no population baseline is ever presented as personal

tier_b_classifier.smoothing: a[i] = median(R[j] for j in [S+i-1, S+i+1] intersected with [0, E]) - centered 3-minute median on R truncated at E (2-value median = mean at the edges)

phase_bin.rule: bin = number of edges <= absolute minute

tier_b_classifier.state: state[i] = +1 if a[i] >= E(i); -1 if a[i] <= -E(i); else 0 (no hysteresis)
tier_b_classifier.sustained_run: maximal block of equal non-zero state with length >= 3
tier_b_classifier.mirror_rule: label(enemy view) = mirror(label(your view)): LE <-> DR, *_FOR <-> *_AGAINST, CT <-> CT, UNCLEAR <-> UNCLEAR, SHORT_WINDOW <-> SHORT_WINDOW; a required test

shape_confidence.definition: share of the 34 perturbations below whose label equals the unperturbed label; percentile perturbations use reference_percentiles

tier_b_classifier.structures: towerDeaths rows classified tower or barracks by npcId (ancient, fillers and other buildings excluded); owner = isRadiant; net for a side = enemy structures destroyed minus own structures destroyed
superseded_research_elements: moderate signals (C_LANE_NW_CS, X_LANE_VS_OTHER_LANES, C_SPIKE_RICH_ITEM, RICH_MOD, SMOKE_MOD, OBSCLEAR_MOD, STACK_MOD, X_HIDDEN_MULTI, C_ECON_STACK_RICH)
'Tier A first, then Tier B' fallback

vision_reconstruction.status: VALIDATED - approved for V1 (fresh 33-match playback holdout, 2026-09-16)
vision_reconstruction.canonical_method: stats-only reconstruction for both vision cards; playback wardEvents are not used for card eligibility in V1

inputs.own_observers: stats.wards rows with type == 0 of your players: (time t0, positionX, positionY), sorted by (t0, x, y)
inputs.enemy_sentries: stats.wards rows with type == 1 of enemy players: (time, positionX, positionY)
inputs.clears: stats.wardDestruction rows with isWard == true of enemy players: time, sorted ascending
inputs.coordinates: STRATZ cell units (1 cell = 64 world units); distance = Euclidean in cells

algorithm: for each clear time t in ascending order:
candidates = own observers i with t0_i <= t < min(t0_i + 360, durationSeconds) and i not in taken
for each candidate i: evidence_i = enemy sentries placed at time ts with t - 90 <= ts <= t and distance(sentry, observer_i) <= 10
scored = candidates with non-empty evidence, scored by (min distance, min age t - ts, index i)
if exactly one scored candidate: pick it (tier A)
else if >= 2 scored and best.min_distance + 3 < second.min_distance (after sorting by score): pick best (tier A)
else if exactly one candidate (scored or not): pick it (tier C)
if picked: add to taken; identified clear = {t, t0, x, y, life = t - t0, region = region(x, y, your side)}
vision_reconstruction.no_second_pass: the research code's second (tier B) pass ran with W2 = 0, R2 = 0 and its picks were discarded; V1 has no second pass
vision_reconstruction.unresolved: never guessed, never counted; displayed counts are lower bounds

rule: if label ends with BASE or FOUNTAIN: OWN_BASE if (label starts with RADIANT) == (your side is Radiant) else ENEMY_BASE
else if |x + y - 252| <= 10 or label in {RIVER, ROSHAN}: RIVER
else: radiant_half = (x + y < 252); OWN_HALF if radiant_half == (your side is Radiant) else ENEMY_HALF

vision_reconstruction.recheck: re-validate after any patch that changes observer/sentry mechanics or the map layout (region cells, river diagonal)

candidates.magnitude: max enemy lead (gold) over the core curve
candidates.safe_claim: You trailed by {deficit} at {deficit_minute} and won. If still behind at the end: won despite trailing by {deficit}.

candidates.eligibility: team lost AND max(L(t)) over the core curve >= ladder.q
candidates.magnitude: max own lead (gold) over the core curve
candidates.safe_claim: Your team led by {lead} at {lead_minute} and lost.

candidates.eligibility: on the core curve: sign(t) = +1 if L(t) >= 1500, -1 if L(t) <= -1500, else 0; sustained run = maximal block of equal non-zero sign with length >= 3 minutes; flip = two consecutive sustained runs (in run order) of opposite sign whose second run starts at minute >= lane_end (STANDARD 12, TURBO 9); flip magnitude = min(max|L| inside run 1, max|L| inside run 2); qualifying flip = magnitude >= ladder.q; display the LATEST qualifying flip
candidates.magnitude: min(peak before, peak after) of the displayed flip
candidates.safe_claim: Your team led by up to {peak_before} ({run_before}); then the enemy led by up to {peak_after} ({run_after}). Result always stated.
forbidden_claim: the fight at X flipped the game

candidates.severity: history: STRONG if N = 50 OR |value| >= core lane-gap p95 (STANDARD 2,254 / TURBO 4,449); EXTREME if both; otherwise NOTABLE; level = (band - 1) + min(0.99, N / 50)
candidates.safe_claim: Your lane gap at {late} was {value}: your {best|worst} across your last {N} {mode} {role} matches (previous {previous_record}).

candidates.display_name: Extreme Opponent Start vs Your History
candidates.eligibility: viewer effective role is a core; lane counterpart resolved; value = counterpart CS at late (sum of lastHitsPerMinute[0..late-1]); value >= population p90 for the counterpart position; value > max(window) (strict); window = most recent <=50 prior comparable counterpart-CS values (same bucket + effective role); N >= 20
candidates.severity: history: STRONG if N = 50 OR value >= population p95 for that position; EXTREME if both; otherwise NOTABLE; level = (band - 1) + min(0.99, N / 50)
candidates.safe_claim: Their {hero} had {value} CS at {late}: the most an opposing {position} has had against you across your last {N} {mode} {role} matches.

candidates.display_name: Own Key Item Timing vs Your History

candidates.severity: history: STRONG if N = 50 OR (min(window) - t) >= 120 s (STANDARD) / 60 s (TURBO); EXTREME if both; otherwise NOTABLE; level = (band - 1) + min(0.99, N / 50)
candidates.safe_claim: Your {time} {item} was your fastest across your last {N} {mode} {role} {item} purchases (previous {previous_fastest}).

candidates.eligibility: duration >= 20:00; enemy stacks = sum over enemy players of campStack[19]; own stacks likewise; enemy stacks >= 7 AND enemy stacks - own stacks >= 4
candidates.safe_claim: Their team stacked {enemy} camps by 20:00; yours stacked {own}.

playback_usable: sum of itemUsedEvents over all ten players > 0
count of enemy itemUsedEvents with itemId 188 == enemy stats itemUsed count for itemId 188
rule: n = enemy Smoke activations t1 < t2 < ... < tn (playback itemUsedEvents, itemId 188); n >= 3
window(i) = (t_i, min(t_i + 60, t_{i+1})]; the last window is (t_n, t_n + 60]
kill = a death of a hero on your team (deathEvents on your players) whose attacker heroId belongs to the enemy team
k = number of windows containing >= 1 kill
f = number of windows containing >= 1 kill whose joined killEvents row (enemy killer, same target + time) has isSmoke == true
fire when k >= 3 AND k >= 0.70 x n AND f >= 2
non_rules: isSmoke never appears in displayed numbers

forbidden_claim: {k} Smokes resulted in / led to kills
